text:
ellen (People Ops): Thanks everyone for the all‑hands — leaving this thread open for quick comp / leveling / promo / benefits Qs we didn’t get to. Drop short Qs and we’ll answer through the day. To start: what's the timing for merit increases and any retroactive adjustments? cc @alex (Finance) @jay (People Ops Lead)

alex (Finance): Merit increases are applied in the payroll cycle following approvals. For example, approvals sent this week hit the next payday (usually ~2 pay cycles). Retroactive pay is only for cases where promotion paperwork is submitted late but effective date was earlier — we handle those case-by-case. I can DM details if needed. :slightly_smiling_face:

maria: quick clarify — my manager is on leave. If they miss submitting manager feedback for leveling, does that block my promotion/raise? worried about timelines.

jay (People Ops Lead): We do outreach to managers on leave. Missing manager feedback doesn't automatically block you — we pull peer feedback, self-evals, and the calibration panel still reviews. If there's a real gap we may ask you for a short written summary to include. Please ping me directly if this is urgent.

tiara: what's the appeals window if we disagree with calibration outcome?

jay (People Ops Lead): You have 7 calendar days from the notification email to file an appeal with People Ops. Appeals need context (manager notes, examples, goal progress). Appeals are reviewed by a small panel — not a guarantee, but we will surface any missed evidence.

simon: are comp band midpoints changing for next fiscal? wondering if anyone on IC track should expect band movement vs just merit.

alex (Finance): Bands are reviewed annually with leadership and Finance. There will be targeted adjustments for roles with market pressure, but broad band resets are rare mid‑year. We publish any band updates alongside the compensation newsletter next quarter.

maria: and if a manager delayed a promotion approval and we backdate, how do bonuses work for that retroactive period?

alex (Finance): Bonus eligibility is governed by the effective date of the promotion in the HR system. Short answer: if promotion effective date falls inside the bonus reporting window, it affects pro‑rata calculations. DM me your case and I'll run the numbers.

ellen (People Ops): For folks asking process questions — we put a short FAQ and checklist here: https://redwood-internal.docs/peopleops/comp-leveling-faq (permissions: all employees). Also running People Ops office hours Wed 3–4pm PT — calendar invite is open to all. If you need 1:1 help outside that slot, reply here and we'll triage.

maria: thanks — can we get a short template for the "manager absent" summary you mentioned so it's consistent?

jay (People Ops Lead): Yup — here's a 3‑bullet template you can copy:```- Role / current comp band and proposed band
- 2 concrete examples of impact (quarter + metric or outcome)
- Expected level growth and timeline```Post it here or DM me and I’ll attach to your packet.

tiara: small benefits Q — any update on the mental health EAP vendor? medical plan changes?

ellen (People Ops): EAP vendor switch is scheduled for May 1 — communications will go out next week with a one‑pager and how to access. Medical plan changes: no plan design changes this cycle, just admin updates. More detail in the benefits newsletter later today.

simon: :eyes: appreciate the clarity. one last ask — can we get a high level flowchart of "what happens after manager submits approval" (timing + payroll + notification)? That helps teams coordinate.

ellen (People Ops): Good idea. I'll post a simple flowchart in this thread by EOD. For now: manager approval -> People Ops review -> compensation committee / calibration -> approvals entered into HRIS -> payroll pickup (2 cycles).

hr-bot: Reminder: calibration docs are due by 11:59pm PT on Friday. Please upload to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/comp-calibration.

ellen (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have private or complex cases, please DM People Ops or book a slot in the office hours calendar. We’ll update this thread with the flowchart and the manager‑absent template.
